negative_findings.description: Finclub.net was fetched directly and, despite being the leading specialist Ukrainian banking news agency, its current front page shows no payment-card, ATM or transaction-statistics coverage — the beat is deposits, lending, insurance and regulation.
negative_findings.result_summary: Verified by fetch: sections are Новини / Статті / Пряма мова / Розслідування / Інфографіка; no payment-infrastructure statistics on the observed page.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents over-weighting an obvious-looking source for A4 payment statistics; it should be tasked for executive quotes and bank strategy instead.

negative_findings.description: No Ukrainian-language trade outlet dedicated specifically to ATM/self-service and cash-handling (the CIT / ATM-deployer beat) was found — searches on банкомат-focused terms returned generic finance portals restating NBU aggregates plus one bank capex story.
negative_findings.result_summary: Six uk searches surfaced no ATM-industry-specific Ukrainian trade publication or independent ATM-deployer newsletter.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: ATM fleet economics, replacement cycles and independent deployer activity in UA will have to be reconstructed from bank press releases, procurement records and vendor sources rather than from a trade outlet.

negative_findings.description: Prostobankir.com.ua, historically the main banker-facing analytics portal, presents only http and its indexed analytics pages look dated; current publishing cadence was not established within this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Listed as a candidate with reduced credibility/confidence and flagged for a freshness check rather than dropped.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: If dormant it is still a valuable pre-war baseline archive for card and channel research; if live it is a high-value B2B source. The distinction changes collection design.

negative_findings.description: A large share of uk-language 'analytics' on cards, POS terminals and ATM counts is verbatim restatement of the same NBU payment-system release, circulating across censor.net, minfin, skilky-skilky, finteco and fixygen within days.
negative_findings.result_summary: The same 2025 figures (15.7k ATMs, 558.6k terminals, 9,512.3m card operations, UAH 7,157.2bn) recur across multiple outlets found in one search.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Counting these as independent corroboration would inflate confidence in a single primary series; the collector must deduplicate by underlying release.

coverage_gaps.description: No regional or second-tier-bank-focused Ukrainian trade media were identified in this pass; all candidates are Kyiv-centric national outlets covering the large banks (PrivatBank, PUMB, Sense, Oschad) and national PSPs.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted uk searches per oblast and per second-tier bank name (e.g. банк + область + банкомати/термінали) and check regional business portals and oblast press for bank-branch/ATM network stories.

coverage_gaps.description: Only text media were assessed. Ukrainian fintech/banking podcasts, YouTube channels and conference video (including EMA and trade-outlet events) were not searched, yet executives often give the most specific unpublished numbers on stage or on camera.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add a dedicated pass over YouTube/podcast feeds of psm7, Fintech Insider, Banker.ua, Mind and EMA event recordings; plan transcript-based collection.

coverage_gaps.description: Paywall/subscription status was only verified for Fintech Insider and Finclub; Forbes Ukraine, Mind.ua, NV and Interfax paywall tiers are assumed, not tested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic verification pass record HTTP status, paywall markers and robots.txt for every candidate before designing collection.

coverage_gaps.description: PSP/acquirer-side trade coverage is thinner than bank-side: NovaPay, iPay.ua, Portmone, LiqPay, Fondy, EasyPay and Concord-successor acquirers were only touched incidentally, and no PSP-specialist outlet was located.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Snowball each named PSP through the EMA member list and each outlet's tag pages to build a per-actor interview inventory.

brief: Ukraine's uk-language banking/payments trade press has three usable layers: two genuine sector specialists (PaySpace Magazine/psm7 and Fintech Insider) that combine NBU-statistics digests with a steady stream of named bank and PSP executive interviews; a set of finance portals and analytics sites (Minfin, Banker.ua, Bankografo, Finbalance, Finteco, Finance.ua) that restate and chart the same regulator series; and higher-editorial business media (Mind.ua, Forbes Ukraine, Interfax-Ukraine interviews) where original figures and the acquiring/interchange debate actually get argued out. The dominant risk is derivative circulation — a single NBU payment-system release reappears near-verbatim across many outlets within days, so deduplication by underlying release is mandatory before any figure is treated as corroborated. The EMA association and processor press indexes (UkrCard, PUMB) function as pointer layers that map which executives speak where. Main gaps: no ATM/self-service-specific Ukrainian trade outlet, no regional/second-tier coverage yet, and no pass over podcast/video where the least-published numbers tend to be spoken.
